build_momentum_network: build a momentum encoder teacher network initialized from the student model with DDP or FSDP wrapping
update_momentum_network: update the momentum teacher parameters using exponential moving average with optional cosine schedule
create_momentum_teacher: create a momentum teacher model as EMA of the student for self-supervised learning losses
review_momentum_teacher_hook: review the MomentumTeacherInLossHook class that manages teacher-student EMA updates
test_momentum_network_update: test the momentum network EMA update with cosine decay schedule over training iterations
